report_policy.core_research_question: How much do the per-pair measurements behind the JSD-versus-transition-width result vary across the three fixed sentence frames, and is that variation large enough to weaken trust in the result?

checklist.request: is there significant variation across 'frames'? i guess that weighs on how much we can trust this result. Can you write a separate report to show how much variation are across the three frames? like a histogram of the range of JSd and a histogram of the range of w, and a new JSD plot but now each scattered point has error bars representing the range. Include those plots in the new report. Do not touch the old report

triage_notes: Destination: the feedback asks for 'a separate report' and names no file. A new file REPORT_frame_variation.md is created; REPORT.md ('the old report') is declared unchanged.
'range' is read literally: per token pair, maximum minus minimum of the quantity over the three sentence frames.

'range of JSd': the corpus next-token JSD is one context-free number per pair and cannot vary across frames; the only JSD measured per frame is the model-output JSD (REPORT.md Methods). The JSD-range histogram therefore uses the per-frame model-output JSD, and the new report must say this plainly, including that corpus JSD has zero frame range by construction.

'a new JSD plot ... error bars representing the range': the JSD-versus-width scatter redrawn with each pair's min-to-max range over frames as error bars (vertical for w; horizontal only where the x quantity is the per-frame model-output JSD). Both the corpus-JSD and model-output-JSD versions are shown so neither reading is dropped.
'this result' = the trained 1.4B JSD-versus-width association; both pair sets in REPORT.md (1,000-pair and controlled 60-pair) are covered.
If per-frame model-output JSD is not already stored in results/, it is recomputed with the existing pipeline (same model, hook, frames); no other experiment is rerun.
Note for the wrapper: the existing REPORT.md is 10,676 words / 11 figures, over the default budget, and cannot be shortened here because the feedback forbids touching it.
